system.description:
Range 60ft; one creature; Will negates. It is sent to an extradimensional labyrinth for 10 minutes. A solo creature can spend a use of Legendary Resistance to step out at the end of any of its turns. At the end of each of its turns it makes an escape check (d20 + Int modifier + half its Level) vs spell DC; on a success it leaves and reappears in the nearest open space; otherwise it stays until the 10 minutes end. Minotaurs leave automatically. Teleportation and planar travel do not work inside.

Classes: Wizard
